meta_description: DBH Plumbing & Heating offer expert plumbing and heating services across Leicester. Fast response, competitive rates, and quality workmanship. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Leicester's Trusted Heating Specialists
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, and heating faults fixed fast — professional service you can count on, when you need it most.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full bathroom installations, DBH Plumbing & Heating covers every aspect of your home's plumbing and heating needs.

services.title: Boiler Repair & Servicing
services.desc: Fast diagnosis and repair of all boiler makes and models, keeping your home warm and your energy bills down. Annual servicing helps prevent costly breakdowns before they happen.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full central heating system design and installation for new builds and older properties alike. We use quality components and back every installation with a comprehensive guarantee.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, and plumbing failures dealt with promptly across Leicester. We aim to reach you quickly and resolve the problem on the first visit wherever possible.

services.title: Bathroom Fitting
services.desc: Complete bathroom installations from strip-out through to the finishing touches, including tiling, pipework, and sanitary ware fitting. Tidy, reliable work with minimal disruption to your home.

services.title: Radiator & Underfloor Heating
services.desc: Radiator installation, replacement, and power flushing to restore full heating efficiency throughout your property. We also install energy-efficient underfloor heating systems in new and existing rooms.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: Fully certified Gas Safe inspections and CP12 landlord certificates issued promptly to keep your rental property legal and your tenants safe. Competitive rates for portfolio landlords.

about_pullquote: Every job we take on, we treat it as if it were our own home.
about_para_1: DBH Plumbing & Heating was founded with a simple aim: to bring honest, skilled, and reliable plumbing and heating services to homeowners and landlords across Leicester. Built on word-of-mouth recommendations, the business has grown steadily by consistently delivering quality workmanship and straightforward, no-nonsense pricing.
about_para_2: What sets DBH apart is a genuine commitment to getting the job done properly the first time. Customers return time and again because they trust us to turn up when we say we will, work cleanly, and never add unexpected charges to the bill. That reputation matters to us, and we work hard to earn it on every single visit.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About DBH Plumbing & Heating

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service from start to finish. Called DBH in the morning about a leaking pipe and they were with us within the hour. The job was done quickly, tidily, and at a very fair price. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in on one of the coldest nights of the year and DBH came out the same evening. Really professional, explained everything clearly, and had the heating back on before bedtime. Fantastic service — five stars without question.
reviews.author: Karen W.

reviews.text: Used DBH for a full bathroom refit and couldn't be happier with the result. They were punctual every day, left the place spotless each evening, and the finished bathroom looks stunning. Genuinely one of the best tradespeople I've ever hired.
reviews.author: Michael B.
